001package com.fs.starfarer.api.ui;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import java.awt.Color;
006
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableStat;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.StatBonus;
009
010/**
011 * x, y are cell coordinates, not screen coordinates. "Row" in this interface really means "cell", not a row of cells.
012 * 
013 * @author Alex
014 *
015 */
016public interface DataGridAPI extends UIPanelAPI {
017
018    public interface DataGridRowAPI extends UIPanelAPI {
019        LabelAPI getNameLabel();
020        LabelAPI getValueLabel();
021    }
022
023    String getValueFont();
024    void setValueFont(String font);
025    String getNameFont();
026    void setNameFont(String font);
027
028    /**
029     * Put the value on the left, right justified in its space valueWidth pixels wide, with gap pixels to the right,
030     * and the label to the right of the gap. Applies to all rows/cells.
031     * @param valueWidth
032     * @param gap
033     */
034    void setFlipped(float valueWidth, float gap);
035
036    float computeHeight(int rowCount);
037    void autoSizeToRows(int rowCount);
038
039    float getItemWidth();
040    float getUnitsWidth();
041    float getRowHeight();
042
043    DataGridRowAPI updateRowText(int x, int y, String text);
044    DataGridRowAPI getRow(int x, int y);
045
046    float getHpad();
047    void setHpad(float pad);
048
049    /**
050     * Number of rendering passes for fonts. 
051     * @param count
052     */
053    void setNumAA(int count);
054    
055    /**
056     * Spacing between rendering passes for fonts.
057     * @param increment
058     */
059    void setAaIncr(float increment);
060    void setFontSize(float size);
061
062    void setFontConfigForBarFont();
063    void setFontConfigForSmallInsignia();
064
065    void setNameColor(Color color);
066    void setValueColor(Color color);
067    void setUnitsColor(Color color);
068
069    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, String nameText, String valueText);
070    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, String nameText, String valueText, String unitText);
071    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, int w, int h, String nameText, String valueText, String unitText);
072    DataGridRowAPI addOrUpdate(int x, int y, String nameText, String valueText);
073    DataGridRowAPI addOrUpdate(int x, int y, int w, int h, String nameText, String valueText);
074    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, String nameText, StatBonus stat, float baseValue);
075    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, String nameText, StatBonus stat, float baseValue, boolean decimalFormatting, boolean showPercent, boolean invertColor);
076    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, String nameText, String valueText, Color valueColor);
077    DataGridRowAPI add(int x, int y, String nameText, String valueText, MutableStat stat, boolean showPercent, boolean invertColor);
078
079    void removeRow(int x, int y);
080    void clearRows();
081
082    int getRowCount();
083    List<DataGridRowAPI> getRows();
084
085    void updateColor(int x, int y, Color valueColor);
086}
